svg.title: Full LSTM pipeline from input words to predicted output words
svg.desc: Each word is embedded and combined with the previous hidden state and a continuously flowing cell state inside the LSTM cell, producing a new hidden state that both threads forward to the next timestep and passes through a linear and softmax layer to predict the next word, while the cell state runs along a separate highway tapped by forget and input gates at each step.

g.text: Cell state c_t — flows on, barely touched

svg.text: Same output wiring as the RNN — the only addition is the teal highway feeding every cell
